general.userProfileDescription: Set how Kila addresses you, which timezone it uses, and which local context it should assume.
general.avatarHint: Click the avatar to upload an image. Fields save automatically on blur.
general.profileUsage: These preferences shape how Kila addresses you, resolves relative dates, and adds local context.
general.profileCurrentContext: Relative dates are currently interpreted in {{timeZone}}, with {{location}} as the location context.
general.basicInfoDescription: Used for addressing you and understanding relative time.
general.locationSectionDescription: Used for local information and regional context.
general.timeZoneDescription: Used for phrases like “tomorrow” or “next week”; falls back to your system timezone when left empty.
general.timeZoneError: Enter a valid IANA timezone such as Asia/Shanghai.
general.cityDescription: Used for weather, local time, and city-level context.
general.countryDescription: Used for regional formatting and broader location context.
general.notificationsDescription: Send notifications when Agent completes tasks or needs action
general.testNotificationBody: If you can see this, completion notifications are working.
general.permissionModeDescription: Controls how regular sessions handle tool permission requests by default. Scheduled tasks and CLI runs can override it independently.
general.permissionModeHint: Auto bypasses all permission prompts. Smart is the default interactive mode and only auto-allows read-only tools while asking for confirmation on other sensitive operations.
general.utilityModelDescription: Specify a dedicated model for lightweight background tasks like title generation; falls back to the current session model if not configured or on failure.
general.utilityProviderDescription: Only enabled providers can be selected.
general.utilityModelHint: Background tasks like title generation prefer this model.
general.unsetProvider: Not configured (falls back to session model)
general.noEnabledModels: No enabled models for this provider

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Automatically allow all tool calls. Use only for fully trusted or unattended runs.

smart.label: Smart
smart.description: Recommended default. Read-only tools and approved whitelist entries pass automatically; other operations ask for confirmation.
